messages:
maria: Heads-up — FinBank wants a short POC with a discounted per-token for hosting trial. They expect ~1.0B tokens over ~3 weeks. Can we do a mid-tier temporary price instead of standard consumption tiers?

alex: @jordan can you run rough cost/ops impact? Finance (@cooper) will want a floor.

jordan: Tech: they'll do long-context tests and heavy sampling — token churn will spike. We can tag traffic and route to dedicated pool with hosted fallback. No infra blocker.

cooper: Finance: we can approve a temporary override if there's a minimum commitment and a clear cap on discounted tokens. What floor are they comfortable with?

maria: They proposed a $15k min and asked for $0.000013/token for the POC window. No auto-renewal; will sign a confirmation email.

riley: Legal: we'll need a one-paragraph POC addendum: start/end dates, billing tag, no automatic rollover, and confirmation of min spend. I can draft if deal-desk provides numbers.

deal-desk: Please include projected tokens, requested rate, min commit, and cap. Approvers: @cooper (finance) and @riley (legal).

sec-bot: Security items: SecQ link outstanding. Customer requested SOC2 report and data residency confirmation. We have SOC2; provide region options.

maria: Submitting details here: projected tokens 1.0B (expected billable 930M), requested temporary rate $0.000013/token, POC 21 days, min commit $15k, override applies up to 1.25B tokens, billing tag: finbank_poc_may2026.

alex: :ok_hand: If legal + finance sign, ops can provision a temporary rate code and routing tag. Jordan, can you prepare route config?

jordan: Will create route: tag=finbank_poc_may2026, policy=prefer-dedicated, fallback=hosted, kv_cache=enabled, metrics=poctest.finbank.

cooper: Finance approves conditionally. Need an invoice calc to show how min commit applies. Also require upfront payment or billing hold?

riley: Legal conditionally approves language. Need a written customer confirmation (signed email fine). No contractual changes beyond POC addendum.

deal-desk: Draft invoice calc for approval:

``
Requested rate: $0.000013/token
Projected billable: 930,000,000 -> $12,090
Min commit: $15,000 -> upfront invoice $15,000
Override cap: 1.25B tokens; excess billed at standard tier post-cap
```

alex: Ops note: we'll tag usage and apply override up to cap. Any overage will be billed at the standard hosted tier automatically.

maria: I'll get the signed email from FinBank and link the SecQ: https://redwoodintake/sec-q/FINBANK-2026. Targeting start next Mon if approvals land today.

cooper: Confirmed — finance ok with the floor and upfront invoicing. Riley, please send your draft; I'll add billing language.

riley: Drafting now, will post in thread in 30m.

maria: Thanks all. Standby for signed confirmation and SecQ completion; we'll queue the technical handoff after legal ok.
